source.title: City of Newton FY2026 Adopted Budget (Functional Element Summary)

meta.note: Newton’s FY2026 adopted General Fund. The bars are the General Fund ($547.6M), where the by-department money lives; Water, Sewer, Stormwater, and Community Preservation are separate funds. Benefits/retirement and debt service are pulled out of their wrapper offices (Comptroller and Treasury) so the real cost drivers show. Every figure is from the adopted budget book, and they add up to the General Fund total exactly.
facts: Schools are 53.5% of the budget — Newton Public Schools at $293.0M, the single largest line.
Newton holds a AAA bond rating from both Moody’s and S&P (reaffirmed Jan 2025) — rare even in Massachusetts.
Police and Fire together are $60.8M, about 11% of the General Fund, versus 53.5% for schools.
